title: CDC Safety Certificate
description: The flagship artefact. Differential: states whether every CDC property that held in golden still holds in revised.

tool_versions.description: MANDATORY. A certificate that does not name its tools is not evidence.

verdict.description: unproven is a first-class result. Never report unproven as pass.

reason.description: on fail: specific and actionable, with file:line

evidence_ref.description: path to the artefact backing this verdict

scope_not_checked.description: MANDATORY. Explicit list of what this certificate does NOT cover. Bounded scope is a trust property.

signature.description: hmac over the canonical JSON of everything above
